text.p: Santa Anita Cos said late on Tuesday that is had restated its results for the 1996 fourth quarter and 1996 full year.

Santa Anita said that the revisions were due to changed circumstances in its preferred stock issued to Colony Investors II LP. The company said the stock has now become redeemable and as a result, its accounting treatment has changed.

While net income/loss remains the same, fourth quarter per share earnings were restated to a loss of $1.60 from a loss of $0.57. Per-share earnings for 1996 were restated to a loss of $0.15 from a profit of $0.05.
Santa Anita also it said restated results for the full 1995 year because an $8.2 million impairment loss should have been reported in previous years.
The 1995 results were restated to a $1.75 a share loss from a $2.45 a share loss.
